verdict.rationale: Google Workspace ships an AI assistant (Gemini in Gmail), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use tools from MCP servers. The Marketplace's "connect your business apps" and the Apps Script automation are adjacent integration features, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
